text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука continues preparing for
the Yayoi
Sho as winter grows colder.
One day, Special
Week asks her to train
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука happily obliges. Seeing
how hard
Спешл Уик works to
improve makes her realize
that other
Umamusume run because they want to

fulfill their dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This discovery unsettles her, and she
begins to
doubt her reasons for running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
